summary: Comprehensive frontend testing completed for Vortex Prime EMU Xbox 360 dashboard. Verified title rename, MC360 font implementation, Guide overlay functionality, sound system integration, controller support, and navigation. Most features working correctly with minor gamerscore display issues during mock authentication.

integration_issues.issue: Home dashboard gamerscore not displaying when mocking signed-in state via localStorage/postMessage
integration_issues.note: Real Xbox authentication may work differently than test simulation

passed_tests: Dashboard title correctly shows 'VORTEX PRIME EMU' (renamed from MY XENIA)
MC360 Blade font properly loaded and applied to 11+ UI elements
Guide overlay opens with Tab key and plays panelUnfold sound
Guide header shows Sign In text, avatar box, and clock (no gamerscore)
Guide menu contains 3 items: XENIA Dashboard, Quick Launch, Shutdown System
Arrow key navigation in Guide with focus sounds (ArrowUp/ArrowDown)
Tab navigation in Guide with panel sounds (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight)
Guide closes with Escape key and plays back sound
Dashboard arrow key navigation with focus sounds
Enter key selects dashboard cards with select sound
Backspace key navigation with back sound
Home button in footer opens Guide overlay
All 6 required sound files accessible (/audio/focus.wav, select.wav, back.wav, panel-unfold.wav, panel-left.wav, panel-right.wav)
Keyboard shortcuts working: Tab, Home, ArrowKeys, Enter, Escape, Backspace
Guide stability tested with multiple open/close cycles
Rapid navigation performance - no lag or freezing
Gamerscore correctly hidden when not signed in
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor issue: Test the gamerscore display functionality with real Xbox authentication flow to ensure it shows properly on home dashboard when signed in. The mock authentication test may not fully replicate the actual React state update flow.
